narr: On July 16th, a lee trough moved into eastern Colorado that allowed slow-moving thunderstorms to develop in east-central Colorado during the evening hours. These thunderstorms produced hail up to penny in size and torrential rainfall causing flash flooding.
ev: Report received of minor street flooding in and around Burlington, CO. Another report of 1.4 inches of storm total rain was received via social media with photo of a rain gauge at one location. This heavy rain produced enough rain for water to reach the running boards on a jeep (estimated 4-6 inches deep).
